generate_with_prefix_beam_search: generate text using beam search with prefix tokens that must begin the decoded sequence
vectorize_prefix_tokens: vectorize prefix text into token IDs using the dictionary txt2vec method for conditioning generation
batchify_with_prefix_vecs: batchify observations into a Batch structure that includes prefix_vecs for each example in the batch
get_prefix_tokens_from_batch: get prefix tokens from a Batch object to seed decoding for each sample in the batch
register_bart_prefix_agent: register a BART agent with prefix generation support using the bart_prefix name for ParlAI
